official_case_scope: Three T3D2 elements; linear modal dynamics, lumped mass, source rho rounded .011111; undamped input uses two tip loads5 adding to10, time step .1 and duration .3.
derived_case_scope: The native production TRUSS logarithmic force and consistent mass are matched by an independently assembled three-DOF ODE. Geometry, material E/A/rho from the public explanatory text, and axial constraints retained; forces1e-6/1 and window10 declared. No claim of original benchmark numerical equivalence.
reference_generation: DOP853 two tolerances and two max_step values, no Newmark implemented or candidate read. Micro-amplitude comparison additionally uses exact generalized modal solution.
matrix_source_limitation: SDLL146 is a mass/inertia check, not a nonlinear transient time-history reference.
